title: 'A masterclass in corporate governance and long-term value creation'
summary: William Milisic — European operator — publishes a substantive review on LinkedIn framing Incorruptible as a masterclass in corporate governance and long-term value creation, and highlighting why the book leans on European case studies (Maersk, IKEA, Novo Nordisk): stakeholder capitalism as an older tradition considering employees, communities, and environment integral to the P&L rather than external to it.
blockquote: While you may know Ries for the "Lean Startup" methodology, what he delivers in "Incorruptible" is a masterclass in corporate governance and long-term value creation. He dismantles the tired dogma of short-term profit maximization and presents a compelling argument that the "financialization" of business is not just bad for society, it's also bad for business.
